_note: Tier 2 batch 1. Prayer-stream material from 26-29 August 2026: Iran, Russia and Ukraine, Europe and the Black Sea.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that the principality he calls the prince of Persia over Iran shrink back, and that Iran's new leaders be dealt with.
mentions.quote: the new leaders of Iran to be dealt with
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a principality shrinking back has no observable signature.

mentions.claim_text: A shaking of Iran's leadership infrastructure with confusion in the camp and leadership dropping like flies, one more round of it, and Russia involved as an extension.
mentions.quote: leadership dropping like flies. There's one more round
mentions.falsify_match: Senior Iranian leadership figures are removed or killed in quick succession, with Russian involvement.
mentions.falsify_miss: Iran's leadership holds without a further round of losses.

mentions.claim_text: A shaking coming to Iran, with Putin seen dressed in black and rigid as a tower of onyx concerning it.
mentions.quote: there's a shaking coming to Iran
mentions.falsify_match: A further upheaval in Iran with Russia holding an immovable position on it.
mentions.falsify_miss: No further upheaval, or Russia's position visibly shifts.

mentions.claim_text: Deals are being made concerning Ukraine, repeated three times, with the word GI Joe heard alongside.
mentions.quote: There's deals that are being made concerning Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: An agreement over Ukraine is concluded, negotiated out of public view.

mentions.claim_text: Trump's plan is peace, seen as lavender breathed over Russia, while Macron and others work to provoke a greater war.
mentions.quote: He wants the breath of lavender in Russia
mentions.falsify_match: A US-led settlement with Russia against European resistance.
mentions.falsify_miss: The war widens with American backing, or Europe pushes for settlement.

mentions.claim_text: They are burning and acid-washing files that cannot be covered because the records are digital, with large money in accounts traced to Europe.
mentions.quote: They're burning the files, but but digitally you can't
mentions.falsify_match: Destroyed records are recovered digitally and expose European-linked accounts.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such recovery or exposure occurs.

mentions.claim_text: A mole inside the Democratic party, a Democratic leader, is leaking Trump's plans to the Ukrainian president.
mentions.quote: a Democratic leader leaking stuff to Zalinski. Plans from Trump
mentions.falsify_match: A senior Democrat is identified passing administration plans to Kyiv.

mentions.claim_text: Moles inside the Pentagon, while attention is on Iran, where something major is about to happen that will fizz out like a bottle opened.
mentions.quote: in the Pentagon. There's moles
mentions.falsify_match: A leak from inside the Pentagon is exposed while an Iran event proves smaller than expected.

mentions.claim_text: Ursula von der Leyen, president of the European Commission, named as the head of the witches and seen talking directly to the devil.
mentions.quote: She is the head of the witches
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a spiritual characterisation of a named person with no observable test.

mentions.claim_text: Trump seen as a lion tamer cracking the whip to defuse the pressure toward war and bring purple over Russia.
mentions.quote: Trump is a is a lion tamer
mentions.falsify_match: American pressure visibly de-escalates the Russian front.

mentions.claim_text: MAGA seen as a red balloon losing its air and fluttering at its last breath, with an attempt at a second wind to blow into it.
mentions.quote: The red MAGA MAGA is losing its its its uh air
mentions.falsify_match: The movement visibly deflates and an effort is made to relaunch it.
mentions.falsify_miss: The movement holds or grows without a relaunch.

mentions.claim_text: Ursula von der Leyen is trying to bring a major world war over Europe and is the head of the snake.
mentions.quote: A witch is trying to bring forth war over Europe
mentions.falsify_match: The named official drives Europe into a general war.
mentions.falsify_miss: No general European war, or she is not the driver.

mentions.claim_text: CERN and portals tied to Berlin, where he says they want to set up the Antichrist system around the Pergamon altar.
mentions.quote: Berlin where they want to set up the Antichrist system
mentions.falsify_match: Berlin becomes the seat of a system he would identify as the Antichrist's.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such seat is established in Berlin.

mentions.claim_text: A triangle seen between Netanyahu, the Saudi crown prince and Europe, with the crown prince connecting it to the Middle East.
mentions.quote: I see a triangle and and I'll be real with you
mentions.falsify_match: A three-way alignment forms between Israel, Saudi Arabia and European powers.

mentions.claim_text: A Hitler spirit summoned over Europe out of Berlin, with the swastika rising again and a World War II pattern repeating.
mentions.quote: I see the Hitler spirit. It's a Hitler
mentions.falsify_match: A leader of that character rises in Europe with visible symbolism.

mentions.claim_text: A demonic stone receiving satanic sacrifice, including virgin girls, used to summon the leader he calls the Mahdi.
mentions.quote: they're wanting to bring forth Hitler. It's a spirit of a leader
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: ritual activity asserted without place, participants or date.

mentions.claim_text: A small push with Putin buys time, with lavender on the soil offered as the thing to pray into.
mentions.quote: it will buy some time it some air with some lavender
mentions.falsify_match: A pause or delay in the Russian escalation.

mentions.claim_text: The balance is top-heavy toward war but can still sway to purple, with a major war involving Poland, Belarus and Ukraine because Poland has better weapons.
mentions.quote: Major war Poland. I'm talking major war with Poland
mentions.falsify_match: Poland enters the war as a combatant.
mentions.falsify_miss: Poland stays out of direct combat.

mentions.claim_text: Turkey becomes an ally of Russia alongside Syria, with North Korea and Belarus, and more Asian allies sought for a major world war.
mentions.quote: Turkey will be an ally ally to Russia with Syria
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey aligns militarily with Russia alongside Syria and North Korea.

mentions.claim_text: Turkey is silently involved in the background and will block the strait in its area to close off the Black Sea.
mentions.quote: Turkey will block off the straight in their area
mentions.falsify_match: Turkey closes the Turkish straits to naval traffic.
mentions.falsify_miss: The straits stay open under the existing treaty regime.

mentions.claim_text: England and France are refused passage into the Black Sea with their ships, so they must use long range missiles and jets instead.
mentions.quote: England trying to take their boats and their stuff into the Black Sea
mentions.falsify_match: British and French naval access to the Black Sea is refused and they switch to standoff weapons.

mentions.claim_text: Pay attention because China is quiet, said twice, as they look toward Taiwan.
mentions.quote: Pay attention because China is quiet
mentions.falsify_match: Chinese quiet precedes a move on Taiwan.

mentions.claim_text: Poland is deploying its tanks, which he says he has been interceding over for the last day after being shown things about it.
mentions.quote: Poland is deploying their tanks
mentions.falsify_match: Polish deployments escalate into combat involvement.

mentions.claim_text: The Ukrainian president rejects wartime elections, saying they would split Ukraine, which he reads as America pressing him toward a decision.
mentions.quote: Zalinski rejects wartime elections says would split Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: Ukraine holds wartime elections under American pressure, or the refusal precipitates his removal.

mentions.claim_text: Russia takes half of Ukraine up to Kiev and a new pro-Russia government is installed as a puppet, which brings peace to the area.
mentions.quote: I saw Russia get half of Ukraine all the way up to Kiev
mentions.falsify_match: Russia holds territory to Kiev under a pro-Russian government.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ukraine retains Kiev and its government.

mentions.claim_text: Putin moves to escalate the war with talks at a dead end, reaching deeper toward Moscow's defences than before.
mentions.quote: Putin moves to escalate war in Ukraine with talks at dead end
mentions.falsify_match: Deep strikes reach Moscow and the war escalates.
mentions.falsify_miss: Talks resume and the depth of strikes falls back.

mentions.claim_text: Four men gathered together, England, France, Canada and Australia, which he says he named in advance and now points to.
mentions.quote: England, France and uh Canada and Australia
mentions.falsify_match: Those four governments act together as a bloc.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not act as a bloc.

mentions.claim_text: Saudi Arabia rises to become a world power in a very short time alongside Iraq, the two described as brothers.
mentions.quote: Saudi Arabia rose up out of and became a world power
mentions.falsify_match: Saudi and Iraqi economic and political weight rises together and quickly.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither rises, or they do not act together.

mentions.claim_text: Syria rises out of seemingly nothing under new leadership to become one of the major parts of the world economy.
mentions.quote: I saw uh Syria rise up out of seemingly nothing
mentions.falsify_match: Syria becomes a significant economy under its new leadership.

mentions.claim_text: Manoeuvring over Greenland and pressure on Canada's prime minister to make big decisions because the Canadian economy is in trouble.
mentions.quote: even with Greenland and uh making Carney Canada make his big decisions
mentions.falsify_match: A Greenland move forces Canadian policy decisions under economic pressure.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such move or pressure materialises.

mentions.claim_text: Putin is playing for the long haul while Trump has two years, and he believes Rubio rather than Vance will be chosen.
mentions.quote: I I believe it'll be uh Rubio in Jesus nam
mentions.falsify_match: Rubio becomes the successor candidate rather than Vance.

mentions.claim_text: Putin oppressed rather than possessed by a Tasmanian-devil-like spirit he names Apollyon, which is creating great war.
mentions.quote: not possessing him, but oppressing him, influencing him. Apolon
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a spiritual attribution behind an observable escalation.

mentions.claim_text: He warns over a played clip about terrorist groups and anthrax that a biological rather than nuclear route is the danger.
mentions.quote: I warn I'm warning you a
mentions.falsify_match: A biological attack using an agent of that kind occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He restates seeing 350 million people perish, saying he had assumed it would be something like COVID and now reads it differently.
mentions.quote: I saw the 350 million people perish
mentions.falsify_match: A death toll approaching 350 million from one cause.

mentions.claim_text: Britain begins rationing water tomorrow with car washes closed and garden watering banned, and citizens are told to stock up on food.
mentions.quote: they're rationing all the water in Britain and it starts tomorrow
mentions.falsify_match: UK water rationing and food stockpiling advice are in force.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such measures are in force.

mentions.claim_text: They read a map on air noting how little there is in Wyoming and how Minnesota shows as a single blue light.
mentions.quote: Wyoming don't have any hardly at all
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a map read aloud on air, with no claim attached.

mentions.claim_text: He tells listeners to be ready and keep their lamps full of oil because the Lord is asking who will help bring in the harvest.
mentions.quote: Have your lamp full of oil
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an instruction to the audience with no outcome attached.

mentions.claim_text: He restates that the man has a place at the table and will be a social pariah, and that he saw him coming up out of a bunker symbolically.
mentions.quote: he will be a social social pariah in the days ahead
mentions.falsify_match: He gains a formal seat in negotiations while remaining internationally isolated.

mentions.claim_text: An earthquake in Taiwan with the ring of fire shaking, which he ties back to the major earthquake he says he was repeatedly shown.
mentions.quote: The the Ring of Fire is shaking and quaking
mentions.falsify_match: A continuing elevated rate of large ring-of-fire earthquakes.
mentions.falsify_miss: Ring of fire activity stays at or below its long-run rate.

mentions.claim_text: Warnings given over a year ago about British Columbia and the Yellowstone danger zone, which he says the reports are now catching up with.
mentions.quote: we see about uh British Columbia and uh what the Lord is warning us about
mentions.falsify_match: A major seismic or volcanic event in British Columbia or at Yellowstone.
